notes: Semantic Scholar returned HTTP 429 (rate limited) on several calls; paper_search.py fell back to arXiv/DBLP results in those cases rather than failing the whole query.
DBLP returned HTTP 503 intermittently; not fatal since arXiv/S2 covered the same queries.
Total unique papers after cross-query deduplication by normalized title: 165 (see papers_raw.json).

bibtex_utils.py's `fetch` command errors on import (`ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'pybtex.latexenc'`) across pybtex 0.21-0.26.1; references.bib was hand-built from paper_search.py's own metadata instead.

Platt (1999) predates arXiv/S2/DBLP's typical indexing for this kind of paper and did not surface via search; it was added manually to the report/bibtex from established bibliographic knowledge instead. The 'Default of Credit Card Clients' UCI dataset paper (Yeh & Lien, 2009) was considered as a candidate seminal citation but was dropped from the final report and references.bib rather than cited from unverified memory, since it did not surface via search either.
